elvis_restaurant_bob_garlicsoy.explanation: Edamame pan-fried with garlic, sesame oil, and soy sauce. A popular beer accompaniment in Hawaii.

elvis_restaurant_bob_tapiocacoconut.name: Tapioca Coconut Milk
elvis_restaurant_bob_tapiocacoconut.explanation: A sweet, creamy drink made of coconut milk and chewy tapioca balls at the bottom.

elvis_restaurant_bpo_martini.name: Martini
elvis_restaurant_bpo_martini.explanation: A popular cocktail most commonly made with dry gin and dry vermouth, then garnished with an olive.

elvis_restaurant_bpo_moscowmule.name: Moscow Mule
elvis_restaurant_bpo_moscowmule.explanation: A well-known cocktail made with vodka, lime juice, and ginger beer. High in alcohol content, so be careful not to overdo it.

elvis_restaurant_bpo_oldfashioned.name: Old Fashioned
elvis_restaurant_bpo_oldfashioned.explanation: Bourbon whiskey with sugar cubes and bitters. As its name implies, this drink is a true classic—as well as one of the oldest cocktails in the world.

elvis_restaurant_bpo_redwine.name: Red Wine
elvis_restaurant_bpo_redwine.explanation: A robust, full-bodied red wine. Goes well with meat and other rich dishes.

elvis_restaurant_bpo_whitewine.name: White Wine
elvis_restaurant_bpo_whitewine.explanation: White wine with a fruity and refreshing aroma. Goes well with light seafood dishes.

elvis_restaurant_bpo_tu_alohabeer.name: Hop Lei IPA
elvis_restaurant_bpo_tu_alohabeer.explanation: West Coast style IPA with ample bitterness and dank notes. Multiple layers of big citrus characteristics with fragrant tropical fruit aromatics.

elvis_restaurant_bpo_charcuterie.name: Charcuterie Assortment
elvis_restaurant_bpo_charcuterie.explanation: Assorted meat appetizers such as prosciutto and salami. Ideal for light snacks, or paired with an apéritif.

elvis_restaurant_bpo_slider.name: Slider
elvis_restaurant_bpo_slider.explanation: Despite it being about one-third of a regular burger, many people find its petit size charming. Plus, if you order a bunch of different sliders, it's like taking a tour of the menu.

elvis_restaurant_bpo_nachos.name: Nachos
elvis_restaurant_bpo_nachos.explanation: Warm tortilla chips with heaps of cheese and spicy salsa on top. Each crunch makes you think fondly of Mexico, whether you've been there or not.

elvis_restaurant_bpo_braisedbeef.name: Braised Beef Tendon in Red Wine
elvis_restaurant_bpo_braisedbeef.explanation: Beef sinew stewed until it's tender enough to melt in your mouth. The red wine only enhances its rich, savory flavor.

elvis_restaurant_bpo_smokedoysters.name: Smoked Oysters
elvis_restaurant_bpo_smokedoysters.explanation: Large oysters smoked, then marinated in olive oil. Each bite explodes with drippy, decadent flavor.

elvis_restaurant_bpo_olive.name: Assorted Olive Platter
elvis_restaurant_bpo_olive.explanation: Assorted seedless green and black olives. Perfect as a low-calorie snack or paired with an apéritif.

elvis_restaurant_bpo_lambchops.name: Lamb Chops
elvis_restaurant_bpo_lambchops.explanation: Lamb rubbed with garlic, spices, and herbs, grilled bone-in. The sizzling meat and aromatic spices are enough to put your nostrils in a trance.

elvis_restaurant_blh_orangechicken.name: Orange Chicken
elvis_restaurant_blh_orangechicken.explanation: Deep-fried chicken slathered in a tangy orange sauce. A staple of American Chinese cuisine, popular around the nation.

elvis_restaurant_blh_generalchicken.name: General Tso's Chicken
elvis_restaurant_blh_generalchicken.explanation: Chicken stir-fried in a thick, sweet-and-spicy sauce. Invented in America, but named after a revered military figure from the Qing dynasty.

elvis_restaurant_blh_cashewchicken.name: Cashew Chicken
elvis_restaurant_blh_cashewchicken.explanation: Chicken stir-fried with cashew nuts, chicken stock, soy sauce, and oyster sauce. Another staple of American Chinese cuisine.

elvis_restaurant_blh_broccolichicken.name: Broccoli Beef
elvis_restaurant_blh_broccolichicken.explanation: Flank steak and broccoli stir-fried in oyster sauce. Simple, yet delicious.

elvis_restaurant_blh_Mongoliabeef.name: Mongolian Beef
elvis_restaurant_blh_Mongoliabeef.explanation: Sliced beef and vegetables stir-fried with garlic, soy sauce, and oyster sauce. Often served over steamed rice or noodles.

elvis_restaurant_blh_eggroll.name: Egg Rolls
elvis_restaurant_blh_eggroll.explanation: The ubiquitous American Chinese appetizer. Cabbage, pork, and other tasty ingredients are rolled in a wheat flour wrapper, then deep fried to a beautiful golden brown.

elvis_restaurant_blh_crabrangoon.name: Crab Rangoon
elvis_restaurant_blh_crabrangoon.explanation: Another popular American Chinese appetizer. These wontons are filled with crab meat and cream cheese, then deep fried. Best enjoyed with sweet-and-sour sauce.

elvis_restaurant_blh_steamed shrimp.name: Har Gow
elvis_restaurant_blh_steamed shrimp.explanation: Shrimp wrapped in a clear rice flour wrapper and steamed. Best eaten with vinegar, soy sauce, and a dab of mustard.

elvis_restaurant_blh_soursoup.name: Stir-Fried Bok Choy
elvis_restaurant_blh_soursoup.explanation: Bok choy stir-fried with garlic and oyster sauce, though there are many variations of the recipe. Great as a snack or a side dish.

elvis_restaurant_blh_chowfan.name: Chow Fun
elvis_restaurant_blh_chowfan.explanation: Beef and vegetables stir-fried with flat rice noodles. A filling dish with a Hawaiian twist.

elvis_restaurant_blh_saimin.name: Saimin
elvis_restaurant_blh_saimin.explanation: Often compared to ramen, saimin features thin white noodles in a clear broth, topped with chicken, pork, shrimp, or any other ingredients that suit your fancy.

elvis_restaurant_blh_friedrice.name: Mixed Fried Rice
elvis_restaurant_blh_friedrice.explanation: A deluxe fried rice dish with ingredients such as shrimp and bamboo shoots.

elvis_restaurant_blh_sesamedumpling.name: Sesame Ball
elvis_restaurant_blh_sesamedumpling.explanation: Dim sum made by wrapping sesame paste in dough, covering it with sesame seeds, then deep frying thoroughly. Warm, rich, and gooey in all the right ways.

elvis_restaurant_blh_coke.name: Cola
elvis_restaurant_blh_coke.explanation: The classic American soft drink dating back to the late 19th century. Features a rush of carbonation that tickles the throat and a saccharine sweetness that jolts the system.

elvis_restaurant_blh_chinabeer.name: Chinese Beer
elvis_restaurant_blh_chinabeer.explanation: A pale lager with low bitterness and a refreshing aftertaste that makes it easy to drink. Fun fact: China is the world's leading producer of beer.

elvis_restaurant_blh_shaoxingwine.name: Shaoxing Wine
elvis_restaurant_blh_shaoxingwine.explanation: A traditional wine that's not only good for drinking, but is used for culinary purposes too. Pair it with your favorite Chinese food.

elvis_restaurant_dih_tequila.name: Tequila
elvis_restaurant_dih_tequila.explanation: A distinguished product of Mexico, tequila is a distilled spirit made from the blue agave plant. Strong enough to make you brace for impact, its unique taste pairs well with spicy food.

elvis_restaurant_dih_vodka.name: Vodka
elvis_restaurant_dih_vodka.explanation: Made from grain and filtered through birch charcoal after distillation. It generally has a clean, crisp taste that goes well with salted or vinegared foods.

elvis_restaurant_dih_bourbon.name: Bourbon
elvis_restaurant_dih_bourbon.explanation: An American whiskey with a sweet and smoky taste, aged in barrels that have been charred on the inside. Goes well with crackers, sweets, and other bar snacks.

elvis_restaurant_dih_coke.name: Cola
elvis_restaurant_dih_coke.explanation: The classic American soft drink dating back to the late 19th century. Features a rush of carbonation that tickles the throat and a saccharine sweetness that jolts the system.

elvis_restaurant_dih_tu_alohabeer.name: Aloha Blonde
elvis_restaurant_dih_tu_alohabeer.explanation: Straw-colored blonde ale with a light, crisp, malt backbone and delicate hop finish. Infinitely refreshing!

elvis_restaurant_dih_nachos.name: Nachos
elvis_restaurant_dih_nachos.explanation: Warm tortilla chips with heaps of cheese and spicy salsa on top. Each crunch makes you think fondly of Mexico, whether you've been there or not.

elvis_restaurant_dih_smokecheese.name: Smoked Cheese
elvis_restaurant_dih_smokecheese.explanation: A snack made from smoked cheddar cheese. The taste makes you think of France and the Wild West simultaneously.

elvis_restaurant_dih_beefjerky.name: Beef Jerky
elvis_restaurant_dih_beefjerky.explanation: Thick, homemade beef jerky. Each bite is like ripping into dry steak that's been smoked, marinated, and cured to perfection.

elvis_restaurant_dih_lampfish.name: Lumpfish Caviar
elvis_restaurant_dih_lampfish.explanation: Less expensive than sturgeon roe, but still tasty enough to put on sushi or crackers.

elvis_restaurant_dih_lambchops.name: Lamb Chops
elvis_restaurant_dih_lambchops.explanation: Lamb rubbed with garlic, spices, and herbs, grilled bone-in. The sizzling meat and aromatic spices are enough to put your nostrils in a trance.

elvis_restaurant_dih_pickles.name: Pickles
elvis_restaurant_dih_pickles.explanation: Small cucumbers marinated in white vinegar and flavored with dill and spices.

elvis_restaurant_BTS_seafoodshowcase.name: Chilled Seafood Showcase
elvis_restaurant_BTS_seafoodshowcase.explanation: Enjoy this gorgeous appetizer plate loaded with fresh seafood such as lobster, tuna sushi rolls, poke, shrimp, oysters, sashimi and sea urchin.

elvis_restaurant_BTS_shrimpceviche.name: Shrimp Ceviche
elvis_restaurant_BTS_shrimpceviche.explanation: A refreshing dish serving Hawaiian shrimp with cherry tomatoes, purple onions, pak choi, coconut milk, and yuzu.

elvis_restaurant_BTS_seascallops.name: Maine Sea Scallops
elvis_restaurant_BTS_seascallops.explanation: Seared scallops from the Gulf of Maine served with pumpkin puree, brussels sprouts, and brown butter sage. Enjoy the rich sweetness fill up your mouth.

elvis_restaurant_BTS_tomatobrioche.name: Tomato Brioche 3pc
elvis_restaurant_BTS_tomatobrioche.explanation: Whipped Big Island goat cheese and tomato jam on hard-baked brioches.

elvis_restaurant_BTS_hudsonvalley.name: Hudson Valley Foie Gras
elvis_restaurant_BTS_hudsonvalley.explanation: Foie gras grilled to a crisp on surface crowning the caramel pineapple and crispy brioche, served with gastriqued berries.

elvis_restaurant_BTS_poachedsalad.name: Port Wine Poached Pear Salad
elvis_restaurant_BTS_poachedsalad.explanation: Salad of endive served with goat cheese, candy walnuts and poached pear, dressed with port wine reduction.

elvis_restaurant_BTS_surfandturf.name: Surf and Turf
elvis_restaurant_BTS_surfandturf.explanation: 8 oz. filet steak with Alaskan king crab and lobster tail with miso sauce. The dish is a gorgeous combination of harvests from both land and sea.

elvis_restaurant_BTS_bouillabaisse.name: Bouillabaisse
elvis_restaurant_BTS_bouillabaisse.explanation: Soup of American lobster tail, scallops, shrimp, mussels, clams and Hawaiian white fishes cooked in a tomato-based broth.

elvis_restaurant_BTS_nystrip.name: NY Strip
elvis_restaurant_BTS_nystrip.explanation: A dish of 12 oz. sirloin steak that will whet your appetite with roasted garlic, citrus arugula, parmesan cheese and ponzu butter sauce.

elvis_restaurant_BTS_filetmignon.name: Filet Mignon
elvis_restaurant_BTS_filetmignon.explanation: An 8 oz. center-cut filet steak with roasted maitake mushrooms and broccolini, served with soubise and calf jus.

elvis_restaurant_BTS_saffronrisotto.name: Saffron Risotto (Vegetarian Dish)
elvis_restaurant_BTS_saffronrisotto.explanation: A satisfying dish of risotto filled with sun-dried tomatoes and broccolini and garnished with grilled portobello mushrooms and arugula.

elvis_restaurant_BTS_soufflecheesecake.name: Soufflé Cheesecake
elvis_restaurant_BTS_soufflecheesecake.explanation: Fluffy soufflé cheesecake with passion fruit sauce and blood orange guimauve (marshmallow).

elvis_restaurant_BTS_pineapplecrepe.name: Haupia Pineapple Crêpe Cake
elvis_restaurant_BTS_pineapplecrepe.explanation: Mille crêpe layered with coconut cream and crêpe. Served with thinly sliced candy pineapple and pineapple sorbet.

elvis_restaurant_sol_appetizercaviar.name: Shrimp and Urchin Appetizer (with Caviar)
elvis_restaurant_sol_appetizercaviar.explanation: An appetizer consisting of a shrimp terrine, topped with generous amounts of sea urchin and caviar.

elvis_restaurant_sol_freshsalad.name: Salad du Jour
elvis_restaurant_sol_freshsalad.explanation: Salads made with plenty of fresh organic vegetables picked fresh that morning. The lineup changes daily.

elvis_restaurant_sol_putty.name: Pâté de Campagne
elvis_restaurant_sol_putty.explanation: A sumptuous country-style pâté made with a generous portion of fine pork and foie gras. The rich flavor is addictive.

elvis_restaurant_sol_chateaubriand.name: Chateaubriand Steak
elvis_restaurant_sol_chateaubriand.explanation: A sumptuous steak made from the finest filet meat. Only 21 ounces of this cut can be procured from a single cow. Served with a rich red wine sauce.

elvis_restaurant_sol_todaysoup.name: Soup du Jour
elvis_restaurant_sol_todaysoup.explanation: The chef decides on the best soup of the day based on the quality of the ingredients and the climate. If you miss it today, you may never find it again.

elvis_restaurant_sol_whitewine.name: White Wine
elvis_restaurant_sol_whitewine.explanation: White wine with a fruity, refreshing aroma. Goes well with light seafood dishes.

elvis_restaurant_sol_redwine.name: Red Wine
elvis_restaurant_sol_redwine.explanation: A robust, full-bodied red wine. Goes well with meat and other rich dishes.

elvis_restaurant_sol_todaydesert.name: Dessert du Jour
elvis_restaurant_sol_todaydesert.explanation: One of many handcrafted desserts carefully prepared by the chef. You can enjoy a different flavor every day.

elvis_restaurant_oab_hamburger.name: Hamburger
elvis_restaurant_oab_hamburger.explanation: With a patty made from 100% Hawaiian ground beef, this burger is so American, it might as well sing the national anthem.

elvis_restaurant_oab_cheeseburger.name: Cheeseburger
elvis_restaurant_oab_cheeseburger.explanation: A hearty burger where melted cheese and ground beef mingle in your mouth.

elvis_restaurant_oab_hawaiiburger.name: Hawaiian Burger
elvis_restaurant_oab_hawaiiburger.explanation: A tropical burger featuring a patty made from 100% Hawaiian beef, romaine lettuce, tomatoes, and cheddar cheese. Ideally, it also has pineapples and teriyaki sauce.

elvis_restaurant_oab_friedchicken.name: Fried Chicken
elvis_restaurant_oab_friedchicken.explanation: Seasoned boneless chicken thighs fried with a crispy coating. Eaten with ketchup or a variety of other dipping sauces.

elvis_restaurant_oab_avocadoburger.name: Avocado Burger
elvis_restaurant_oab_avocadoburger.explanation: Features tender, ripe avocados and a top-secret sweet sauce cooked up in-house. Said to be popular among young women, but no marketing data has proven this.

elvis_restaurant_oab_frenchfry.name: Potato Wedges
elvis_restaurant_oab_frenchfry.explanation: Potatoes cut thick, then deep fried and salted. Dip them in some ketchup and enjoy!

elvis_restaurant_oab_cobbsalad.name: Cobb Salad
elvis_restaurant_oab_cobbsalad.explanation: A commonly featured salad in the United States, made of chicken, tomatoes, lettuce, avocado, hard-boiled eggs, and other little goodies cut into cubes.

elvis_restaurant_oab_coke.name: Cola
elvis_restaurant_oab_coke.explanation: The classic American soft drink dating back to the late 19th century. Features a rush of carbonation that tickles the throat and a saccharine sweetness that jolts the system.

elvis_restaurant_oab_icekona.name: Iced Kona Coffee
elvis_restaurant_oab_icekona.explanation: Kona coffee served on ice. The coolness and refreshing acidity are pleasant on a hot day.

elvis_restaurant_oab_gingerale.name: Ginger Ale
elvis_restaurant_oab_gingerale.explanation: This carbonated, thirst-quenching, and slightly aromatic ginger drink is a refreshing classic.

elvis_restaurant_rev_frenchfry.name: Potato Wedges
elvis_restaurant_rev_frenchfry.explanation: Deep-fried potatoes shaped into long, thin strips, then salted and dipped in ketchup. An indispensable feature of American fast food.

elvis_restaurant_rev_masterpickles.name: Homemade Pickles
elvis_restaurant_rev_masterpickles.explanation: Small cucumbers marinated in white vinegar and flavored with dill and spices.

elvis_restaurant_rev_sangria.name: Homemade Sangria
elvis_restaurant_rev_sangria.explanation: An alcoholic punch made with carefully selected fruits soaked in wine. The fresh aroma only enhances the taste.

elvis_restaurant_rev_maitai.name: Mai Tai
elvis_restaurant_rev_maitai.explanation: A powerful cocktail featuring rum and lime juice. Some recipes call for orange or pineapple juice instead, giving it a sweeter, fruitier taste.

elvis_restaurant_rev_bourbon.name: Bourbon
elvis_restaurant_rev_bourbon.explanation: An American whiskey with a sweet and smoky taste, aged in barrels that have been charred on the inside. Goes well with crackers, sweets, and other bar snacks.

elvis_restaurant_rev_coldsake.name: Cold Sake
elvis_restaurant_rev_coldsake.explanation: The owner's personal stock of sake imported from Japan, a luxury for those in Hawaii.

elvis_restaurant_mhd_pizza.name: Pizza
elvis_restaurant_mhd_pizza.explanation: For when you're hungry even in the middle of a poker game. Just don't get grease on the cards.

elvis_restaurant_mhd_frenchfry.name: French Fries
elvis_restaurant_mhd_frenchfry.explanation: Play cards with one hand, grab a stick of hot, potatoey goodness with the other.

elvis_restaurant_mhd_tortillachips.name: Tortilla Chips
elvis_restaurant_mhd_tortillachips.explanation: Warm, healthy tortilla chips served with chipotle sauce and salsa. Each crunch makes you think fondly of Mexico, whether you've been there or not.

elvis_restaurant_mhd_chickennugget.name: Chicken Nuggets
elvis_restaurant_mhd_chickennugget.explanation: Crispy, fried nuggets served with an original dipping sauce.

elvis_restaurant_mhd_curry.name: Curry
elvis_restaurant_mhd_curry.explanation: Japanese curry made with savory beef tendon. One bite's all it takes to make you an instant fan.

elvis_restaurant_mhd_spade.name: Spade
elvis_restaurant_mhd_spade.explanation: A mocktail made with popcorn syrup. Great for when you need to lift your spirits.

elvis_restaurant_mhd_heart.name: Heart
elvis_restaurant_mhd_heart.explanation: A mocktail inspired by the suit of hearts. A refreshing combination of blood orange and ginger ale.

elvis_restaurant_mhd_diamond.name: Diamond
elvis_restaurant_mhd_diamond.explanation: The unique flavors of lavender and grapefruit pair perfectly in this original mocktail.

elvis_restaurant_mhd_clover.name: Club
elvis_restaurant_mhd_clover.explanation: A mocktail inspired by the suit of clubs. Features the sweet, tangy taste of kiwi.

elvis_restaurant_mhd_aa.name: AA
elvis_restaurant_mhd_aa.explanation: A vodka and tonic worthy of the strongest starting hand in poker. Tingly refreshment in liquid form.

elvis_restaurant_mhd_kk.name: KK
elvis_restaurant_mhd_kk.explanation: A cocktail made by shaking coffee and vodka with ice. Bitter, creamy, and keeps you from nodding off at the table.

elvis_restaurant_mhd_qq.name: QQ
elvis_restaurant_mhd_qq.explanation: A strawberry liqueur and vodka-based cocktail. Very popular for its fruity flavor.

elvis_restaurant_mhd_jj.name: JJ
elvis_restaurant_mhd_jj.explanation: Jasmine tea leaves infused with shochu. For the distinguished poker player.

elvis_restaurant_mhd_tt.name: TT
elvis_restaurant_mhd_tt.explanation: A unique lemon sour with a distinctive blue color. Each sip will make your lips pucker with delight.

elvis_restaurant_mhd_allIn.name: All-In
elvis_restaurant_mhd_allIn.explanation: Vodka and ginger ale, for those who make bold moves in poker and in life.

elvis_restaurant_yos_nami.name: Beef Bowl (Regular)
elvis_restaurant_yos_nami.explanation: A beef bowl that stands the test of time. Unchanging, true deliciousness.

elvis_restaurant_yos_komori.name: Beef Bowl (Small)
elvis_restaurant_yos_komori.explanation: A beef bowl that stands the test of time. Unchanging, true deliciousness—without the surplus calories.

elvis_restaurant_yos_atama.name: Beef Bowl (Extra Toppings)
elvis_restaurant_yos_atama.explanation: A beef bowl that stands the test of time. Unchanging, true deliciousness—for those craving something extra.

elvis_restaurant_yos_oomori.name: Beef Bowl (Large)
elvis_restaurant_yos_oomori.explanation: A beef bowl that stands the test of time. Unchanging, true deliciousness—for those with big appetites.

elvis_restaurant_yos_tokumori.name: Beef Bowl (Extra Large)
elvis_restaurant_yos_tokumori.explanation: A beef bowl that stands the test of time. Unchanging, true deliciousness—and a mountain of food, to boot.

elvis_restaurant_yos_tyoutoku.name: Beef Bowl (Super Extra Large)
elvis_restaurant_yos_tyoutoku.explanation: A beef bowl that stands the test of time. Unchanging, true deliciousness—for those with bottomless stomachs.

elvis_restaurant_yos_butanami.name: Pork Bowl
elvis_restaurant_yos_butanami.explanation: A fan favorite that's returned to the menu by popular demand. For those seeking something a little different.

elvis_restaurant_yos_gyuunami.name: Kalbi Bowl
elvis_restaurant_yos_gyuunami.explanation: Large slices of the finest kalbi meat grilled with a shoyu marinade.

elvis_restaurant_yos_karaage.name: Chicken Karaage Set
elvis_restaurant_yos_karaage.explanation: Prepared in-house and freshly fried, this juicy karaage is marinated in Yoshinoya's special sauce.

elvis_restaurant_yos_saranami.name: Beef Plate Set (Standard)
elvis_restaurant_yos_saranami.explanation: All the fixings of the regular beef bowl, plus rice, egg, and miso soup.

elvis_restaurant_yos_sarakarubi.name: Beef Plate & Beef Kalbi Set
elvis_restaurant_yos_sarakarubi.explanation: A value meal of kalbi meat grilled in a select shoyu marinade, plus a full beef plate.

elvis_restaurant_yos_gyuusake.name: Beef & Salmon Set
elvis_restaurant_yos_gyuusake.explanation: The best of both worlds—beef and grilled fish. Perfect, even for breakfast.

elvis_restaurant_yos_unazyuu.name: Eel Over Rice
elvis_restaurant_yos_unazyuu.explanation: Hand-picked eel cooked to perfection in our aromatic signature sauce

elvis_restaurant_yos_sutamina.name: Super Large Stamina Bowl
elvis_restaurant_yos_sutamina.explanation: The biggest dish in Yoshinoya history! Beef, pork, and chicken finished off in a shoyu-based garlic sauce!

elvis_restaurant_yos_sarakaraage.name: Beef Plate & Chicken Karaage Set
elvis_restaurant_yos_sarakaraage.explanation: Value meal of filling karaage and our beef plate.

elvis_restaurant_survivor_martini.name: Martini
elvis_restaurant_survivor_martini.explanation: The undisputed king of cocktails. Uniquely dry, with a uniquely distinct flavor.

elvis_restaurant_survivor_buraddhi.name: Red Snapper
elvis_restaurant_survivor_buraddhi.explanation: The fusion of gin, tomato juice, and its secret ingredient—hot sauce—gives this cocktail charm and depth.

elvis_restaurant_survivor_margarita.name: Margarita
elvis_restaurant_survivor_margarita.explanation: A tequila-based cocktail with salt on the rim of the glass. Sour, refreshing, and easy to drink.

elvis_restaurant_survivor_daikiri.name: Daiquiri
elvis_restaurant_survivor_daikiri.explanation: A rum-based cocktail. Enjoy the citrusy aroma and sour notes of lime juice.

elvis_restaurant_survivor_reimenn.name: Cold Noodles
elvis_restaurant_survivor_reimenn.explanation: Chilled noodles the owner made for himself. After a customer witnessed him eating it, it was added to the menu.

elvis_restaurant_survivor_beefjerky.name: Beef Jerky
elvis_restaurant_survivor_beefjerky.explanation: The owner's homemade beef jerky. The black pepper gives it a little kick that's rather addictive.

elvis_restaurant_survivor_olive.name: Assorted Olive Platter
elvis_restaurant_survivor_olive.explanation: Assorted seedless green and black olives.

elvis_restaurant_survivor_specialcurry.name: Special House Curry
elvis_restaurant_survivor_specialcurry.explanation: The owner blends the spices himself to give his original beef curry some extra pizzazz. He will never tell you the recipe.

elvis_restaurant_pla_omeletterice.name: Omurice
elvis_restaurant_pla_omeletterice.explanation: Popular omurice with a top-notch flavor. Fluffy white rice enveloped in egg, served with a demi-glace sauce.

elvis_restaurant_pla_hayashirice.name: Hayashi Rice
elvis_restaurant_pla_hayashirice.explanation: Hayashi rice with a mellow demi-glace sauce. The sweet onions and refreshingly sour tomatoes will stimulate your appetite.

elvis_restaurant_pla_rarecheese.name: No-Bake Cheesecake
elvis_restaurant_pla_rarecheese.explanation: The crust is made of crushed cookies. Then heavy cream and cream cheese are mixed and used for the filling, giving it a smooth, rich taste.

elvis_restaurant_pla_konacoffee.name: Kona Coffee
elvis_restaurant_pla_konacoffee.explanation: One of the most renowned coffee across the globe for its flavor and quality—not too bitter, and quite refreshing!

elvis_restaurant_pla_creamlatte.name: Cream Latte
elvis_restaurant_pla_creamlatte.explanation: A blend of espresso and steamed milk, topped with whipped cream for just the right amount of sweetness.

elvis_restaurant_pla_shekarat.name: Shakerato
elvis_restaurant_pla_shekarat.explanation: Iced coffee made by mixing all the ingredients together in a shaker. The bubbles that form give it a milder flavor.

elvis_restaurant_dan_sazanami.name: Assorted Sashimi Platter (7 kinds)
elvis_restaurant_dan_sazanami.explanation: This platter includes seven kinds of fresh seafood purchased that same day. It may even come with some extras, who knows?

elvis_restaurant_dan_tairyou.name: Assorted Sashimi Platter (12 kinds)
